definition: A big problem or a difficult truth that everyone knows about but no one wants to talk about.
synonyms: the obvious problem no one mentions
example: The falling sales were the elephant in the room; no one at the meeting dared to mention them.

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.line: The meeting was strange. No one talked about the budget cuts.

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.line: Yes, that was the elephant in the room. Everyone knew, but no one said a word.

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.line: Someone has to say it first.

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.line: I will, at the next meeting.
